column1: agony|thorn|荆棘|靴里的荆棘带来极度痛苦，表现 agony。|The thorn in his boot caused him agony on the trail.|A quiet forest trail|One hiker sits on a low rock and carefully removes one thorn from his boot, his face showing intense pain|one thorn;one hiking boot;one walking stick|The hiker stops on the trail;He finds a thorn caught in his boot;He winces as he removes the thorn|One hiker grimaces while pulling a thorn from his boot on the trail.|Show pain through one hiker’s facial expression and posture, with a single thorn caught in the boot; keep the injury mild and non-graphic, with no text or symbols.

bizarre|hat|帽子|鱼形怪帽让整体装扮显得奇异，表现 bizarre。|She wore a bizarre hat shaped like a curled fish.|A simple outdoor parade route|One woman wears one absurd curled-fish hat and smiles at its unusual shape|one curled-fish hat;one coat;one plain street|She picks up the unusual hat;She places it on her head;Its strange shape makes her outfit look bizarre|One woman wears a clearly unusual fish-shaped hat.|Make the hat unmistakably odd but friendly; use no crowd, signs, lettering, or extra hats.

conversely|sun|太阳|花朵在阳光下茂盛；conversely，背阴花床光秃，形成相反对照。|Flowers flourished in the sun; conversely, the shaded bed remained bare.|Two garden beds beside one tall wall|Two adjacent flower beds contrast: the sunlit bed is full of blooms, while the wall shades a bare bed|sunlight;flower bed;tall wall|Sunlight reaches one bed;Flowers flourish in the bright soil;The wall casts shade over the opposite bare bed|One flower bed blooms in sunlight while the adjacent shaded bed stays bare.|Make the two outcomes clearly opposite in one continuous garden scene; no labels, arrows, signs, or text.

dedicate|book|书|她每天早晨把时间投入写书，表现 dedicate 的致力于义。|She would dedicate each morning to writing her book.|A quiet writing desk at dawn|One woman works steadily at a desk with her book and pen as morning light enters|one open book;one pen;one dawn-lit window|She sits down at dawn;She works at the book with her pen;She continues writing as the morning light fills the room|One woman devotes the morning to working on her book.|Show focused steady work; keep pages blank or with no readable marks, and omit clocks, text, signs, or logos.

extinguish|water|水|他把水倒在营火上将其扑灭，表现 extinguish。|He poured water on the campfire to extinguish it.|A safe campsite after sunset|One camper pours one bucket of water over a small controlled campfire|water bucket;small campfire;camping log|A small campfire burns low;The camper tips water from the bucket;The flames go out and only damp ash remains|One camper extinguishes a small campfire with water.|Keep the fire small and safely contained; show no smoke lettering, signs, or extra people.

incur|car|汽车|把车堵在车道会招致罚款，表现 incur。|A driver may incur a fine by leaving his car across the driveway.|A residential driveway mouth with a garage behind it|One parking attendant hands a blank fine slip to one driver beside a car parked crosswise directly across the driveway entrance, visibly blocking the garage|one car parked across the driveway;one completely blank fine slip;one blocked driveway entrance|The driver leaves the car crosswise at the driveway mouth;The parked car visibly blocks access to the garage;The attendant gives the driver a blank fine slip|A car blocks a residential driveway while the attendant hands its driver a blank penalty slip.|Make the car visibly block the full driveway entrance and garage access. Show exactly two adults: a driver and an attendant handing over one entirely blank fine slip. No screens, text, parking signs, painted lettering, license plate characters, logos, or uniform insignia.

invalid|key|钥匙|不合适的钥匙打不开门锁，表现 invalid 的无效义。|The invalid key would not turn in the lock.|A plain wooden front door|One person tries one wrong-shaped key in the door lock, but it will not turn|one key;one door lock;one wooden door|The person brings the key to the lock;The key fails to turn;The locked door remains shut|A key that does not fit leaves the door locked.|Show one key and one lock in a single clear attempt; no warning marks, labels, text, or symbols.

loosen|rope|绳子|她用双手松开绳结，表现 loosen。|She used both hands to loosen the knot in the rope.|A simple workshop table|One woman uses both hands to loosen one tight knot in a rope|one rope;one tight knot;one plain table|The rope lies with one tight knot;The woman grips both sides of the knot;The knot opens and the rope slackens|A woman loosens a knot in a rope with both hands.|Show exactly two hands attached naturally to the woman; no extra loops that resemble separate ropes, and no text.

orchestra|violin|小提琴|小提琴与其他乐器同列，组成管弦乐队，表现 orchestra。|The violin rested among the orchestra’s instruments before the concert.|A small concert stage before a performance|One conductor stands before an arc of empty chairs and a neatly arranged group of orchestral instruments, including one violin|one violin;a group of varied orchestral instruments;one low stage platform|The conductor enters the quiet stage;The violin is placed among strings and other instruments;The full ensemble waits for the concert|One violin sits among a varied orchestral ensemble on a concert stage.|Use only one conductor and no other people; include a violin, cello, horn, and timpani as recognizable instruments. pottery|clay|黏土|她在制陶轮上把黏土塑成碗，表现 pottery。|She shaped clay into a bowl at the pottery wheel.|A small pottery studio with a plain empty wall|One potter shapes one simple unmarked bowl from clay on a pottery wheel|one lump of clay;one pottery wheel;one forming bowl|The lump of clay rests on the wheel;The potter shapes it with both hands;One plain bowl takes form|One potter shapes one unmarked clay bowl on a wheel.|Keep the studio minimal and empty. Show only one vessel: the single plain bowl being formed on the wheel. No shelves, no finished pots, no other pottery, no decorations or marks on the bowl, no writing, symbols, or text.

quantitative|scale|秤|她用秤称量种子并作定量比较，表现 quantitative。|She made a quantitative comparison by weighing seeds on the scale.|A bright research table|One researcher weighs two small seed samples on a balance scale to compare their measured amounts|one balance scale;two seed samples;one plain worktable|The researcher places one sample on each side;The scale responds to their different amounts;She records the comparison without any visible writing|A researcher uses a scale to compare measured seed samples.|Make the weighing scale and two separate samples unmistakable; use no numerals, charts, labels, or written notes.

spectacle|firework|烟花|烟花把夜空变成壮观景象，表现 spectacle。|The fireworks turned the night sky into a spectacle.|An open field at night|A colorful firework display fills the sky above an open field as two friends look up|fireworks;night sky;two watching friends|The night sky is dark;Fireworks burst in a broad brilliant display;The friends look up at the spectacle|Two friends watch a spectacular firework display in the night sky.|Show exactly two viewers; no signs, banners, text, logos, or extra fireworks on the ground.

stripe|zebra|斑马|斑马身上的条纹与浅色皮毛形成明显对比，表现 stripe。|One zebra’s stripe showed clearly against its pale coat.|A quiet grassy savanna|One zebra stands broadside so a single dark stripe is easy to distinguish from its pale coat|one zebra;dark stripes;pale coat|The zebra stands in the grass;Its dark stripes contrast with its pale body;One stripe is clearly visible across the coat|One zebra’s stripe stands out against its pale coat.|Show one zebra with natural anatomy and distinct stripes; no extra animals, fences with markings, or text.

viewpoint|camera|相机|相机从低处拍摄，让她获得观察城市的新视角，表现 viewpoint。|The camera gave her a new viewpoint on the city.|A city overlook at ground level|One photographer crouches low with a camera aimed upward at a tall city tower|one camera;one city tower;one low stone ledge|The photographer lowers the camera near the ground;She aims up toward the tower;The low angle gives her a new viewpoint|A camera held from a low angle gives a new viewpoint on the city.|Make the low camera angle and changed perspective obvious; no screens, text, signs, or logos.

alternate|lantern|灯笼|红灯笼与蓝灯笼沿小路轮流排列，表现 alternate。|Red lanterns alternate with blue lanterns along the path.|A quiet garden path at dusk|A row of red and blue lanterns hangs in a clear alternating sequence along one garden path|red lanterns;blue lanterns;garden path|Red and blue lanterns hang at regular intervals;Each red lantern is followed by a blue one;The alternating sequence continues down the path|Red and blue lanterns take turns along a garden path.|Make the red-blue-red-blue sequence clear and evenly spaced; no writing, signs, or extra colors of lanterns.

Show exactly two adults in plain unmarked clothing.

clash|chair|椅子|两位朋友因争同一把椅子而发生冲突，表现 clash。|The two friends clash over the only chair at dinner.|A modest dining room|Two friends disagree as each reaches for the same empty chair at the table|one chair;one dining table;one plain plate|The friends arrive at the table;Both reach for the only chair;Their opposing gestures show a clash|Two friends clash over one chair at dinner.|Show exactly two people and one chair; make the disagreement nonviolent, with no speech bubbles or text.

converge|bridge|桥|两条小路在石桥前会聚，表现 converge。|Two roads converge at the stone bridge.|A green countryside with a stone bridge|Two narrow paths approach from different directions and meet at one stone bridge|two paths;one stone bridge;one small traveler|The two paths begin apart;They draw closer toward the bridge;Both paths meet at the bridge|Two paths converge at one stone bridge.|Show two distinct paths joining at the same bridge; no signs, maps, arrows, or text.
